description: This PHP source file defines an administrative controller class 'PagesSubController' within the Goteo application framework. The class manages CRUD operations for pages, including adding, editing, and listing pages, with permission checks and event logging. It interacts with model classes such as Page, User, and Feed, and handles HTTP POST requests and redirects in an admin context.

classes.name: Goteo\Controller\Admin\PagesSubController
classes.description: An admin controller for managing page entities, including adding, editing, and listing pages with permission enforcement and logging.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the addition of new pages, processing form submission, creating Page instances, and redirecting accordingly.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Manages editing existing pages, including validation, saving changes, logging modifications, and handling 'pending translation' status.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of all pages.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user is permitted to access pages based on master node configuration.
